* Added full English and Spanish support, including the settings and the example trip
* Added a random example trip to the settings preview when no trip is running
* Added a Source code button at the bottom of the settings: pull past the end to open the repo
* Added a colorful icon and animation to the "Use colorful chip" setting
* Added arrival times read from Transit in any language and clock format
* Fixed the settings crashing on Android 10 and 11
* Fixed notification access: it now opens the plugin's own switch and reconnects after updates
* Fixed "Show After Next Step" changing the example trip
* Fixed the settings title, which now shows the full plugin name
